item.title: It's Medicare open enrollment time. Here's what you need to know
item.description: Open enrollment for Medicare runs through Dec. 7, and there are a few different pitfalls people should watch out for this year. Your drug plan or Medicare Advantage plan could be changing a lot.

item.title: He expected a small-business loan. He got a 7-year nightmare
item.description: America's fastest-growing source of funding for small businesses is also one of the least regulated. One man has waged a long, lonely fight to recoup its punishing cost.

item.title: Trump orders federal contractors to check with White House before responding to Congress
item.description: President Trump is directing federal contractors to consult the White House about inquiries from Congress and to withhold any communications that his administration considers privileged.

item.title: Google employees protest AI in schools policy
item.description: More than 550 Google employees signed a petition to allow schools access to Search without AI. Parents and educators protested outside Google offices in 6 cities last week for the same ask.

item.title: Bayer reaches Roundup settlement that could cost the company billions
item.description: The money will go to thousands of people who have been or will be diagnosed with non-Hodgkin lymphoma – a blood cancer linked to the herbicide.

item.title: Storms expected on both coasts threaten Thanksgiving travel
item.description: The mayor of San Francisco is asking people in the city not to travel unless "absolutely essential." Meanwhile, a storm moving up the Eastern seaboard could also cause travel delays ahead of Thanksgiving.

item.title: Cartel leader captured in northern Mexico in a bloody firefight that left 11 dead
item.description: Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, better known as "El Chapo Isidro," was one of the FBI's most wanted fugitives. His arrest in northwest Mexico on Saturday has sparked violence in the region.

item.title: Killer robots: U.N. talks fall short of hopes for legally binding rules
item.description: U.N. talks in Geneva have failed to deliver binding rules on autonomous weapons, as humanitarian groups warn that military AI is advancing far faster than diplomacy.
